channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Messi's Argentina retirement raises questions about Inter Miami future
item.description: Messi retires from Argentina duty after 207 caps and a World Cup title, but his Inter Miami contract runs through 2028.

item.title: House passes bill cutting federal funds from universities boycotting Israel
item.description: A bipartisan House vote to tie federal funds to Israeli-boycott policies reopens a century-old tension between government spending conditions and constitutional speech protections.

item.title: Ibama clears Petrobras to drill three more Foz do Amazonas wells
item.description: Ibama signed off on three exploratory wells in block FZA-M-59 off Amapá, pushing Petrobras closer to a verdict on its Morpho hydrocarbon find.

item.title: Inter Miami signs Paraguayan midfielder Matías Galarza on loan
item.description: The 24-year-old Paraguayan international arrives on loan from River Plate through the 2026 MLS season, with a buy option attached.

item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to lift block on mail-ballot restrictions
item.description: The administration told the justices that a lower-court block on mail-ballot restrictions will cause irreparable harm ahead of the November midterms.

item.title: North Dakota special session passes kratom regulation, rejects total ban
item.description: The North Dakota Legislature rejected a total kratom prohibition and instead passed a regulatory framework banning synthetic kratom while restricting natural kratom sales to adults.

item.title: Trump threatens trade cutoff with deficit countries if Fed won't cut rates
item.description: Trump threatened to halt trade with deficit countries unless the Federal Reserve cuts interest rates, escalating his public clash with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

item.title: Labor Dept. OIG report details misconduct by ex-secretary Chavez-DeRemer
item.description: The Labor Department's watchdog found the former secretary violated alcohol policies, directed staff on personal tasks, and oversaw a hostile work environment.

item.title: Romanian prosecutors indict Andrew Tate on trafficking and sex charges
item.description: Romanian anti-organized crime prosecutors formally charged Andrew and Tristan Tate on September 4, 2026, while the brothers remain in U.S. custody.

item.title: Trump expected to sign beef executive order Friday
item.description: Two sources told Reuters the president is set to sign an order tied to country-of-origin labeling at 1:30 p.m. ET Friday.

item.title: Mexico and US show uneven recovery as USMCA review tests AI governance
item.description: Mexico's economy stumbled in early 2026, rebounded unevenly, and now faces a USMCA review that puts AI rules and data policy at the center.

item.title: Márquez weighs Romero and Campillo for first Mexico call-up
item.description: Márquez's first squad announcement arrives the week of September 14–18, with Romero's national-team choice and Campillo's Liga MX form both unresolved.

item.title: Latino voters emerge as key swing bloc in 2026 midterms
item.description: With 36.2 million eligible Latino voters representing 15 percent of the national electorate, both parties are competing aggressively for a bloc that could decide competitive races.

item.title: AFA orders nationwide minute of applause for retired Messi
item.description: The AFA ordered a 60-second applause pause at the 10th minute of every domestic match to honor Messi's retirement from the national team.

item.title: All-Liga MX final set for 2026 Leagues Cup on September 6
item.description: All four semifinalists are Liga MX clubs, ending MLS's three-year winning streak and guaranteeing a Mexican champion on September 6.

item.title: US adds 162,000 jobs in August, beating forecasts
item.description: The Labor Department's August payroll count of 162,000 far exceeded Wall Street forecasts and marked the strongest monthly gain since March.

item.title: Trump calls Britain 'on the edge of disaster' over immigration and energy
item.description: Trump told GB News that Britain faces collapse on immigration and energy, while urging London to abandon net-zero targets and exploit North Sea reserves.

item.title: Brazilian Martinelli joins Al-Hilal from Arsenal in record deal
item.description: Arsenal sold Gabriel Martinelli to Al-Hilal for £60 million, setting a new club transfer record and ending a seven-year stint in north London.

item.title: Judge blocks Trump's August birthright citizenship executive order
item.description: U.S. District Judge Deborah Boardman issued a preliminary injunction September 2 against President Trump's August executive order limiting birthright citizenship.

item.title: El Niño threatens Peru's growth and Latin America's vulnerable housing
item.description: Peru trims its growth outlook as El Niño looms, while 120 million Latin Americans in informal housing brace for the worst.

item.title: Brazil liquidates two firms tied to Banco Master scandal
item.description: Brazil's central bank shut down Trustee and Banvox on September 3, pushing 2026 financial closures to a 24-year high of 17.

item.title: US reviews deadly strike on Iranian wedding as analysis points to US munition
item.description: CENTCOM has ordered an internal review after weapons analysts told Reuters the munition was likely American, not an errant Iranian interceptor.

item.title: Mourinho says he will watch MLS to see Messi after Argentina retirement
item.description: Messi retires from Argentina after 207 caps and 125 goals, and Mourinho says he'll reluctantly tune into MLS to keep watching him.

item.title: White House launches arcade games promoting immigration enforcement
item.description: A government arcade invites us to play at the border—and raises durable questions about how states have always used spectacle to normalize policy.

item.title: Inter Miami sign Paraguay midfielder Galarza on loan from River Plate
item.description: The 24-year-old Paraguayan arrives on loan from River Plate through the end of the 2026 MLS season, with Inter Miami holding a purchase option.

item.title: Nobel economist Heckman visits Argentina, backs Milei deregulation push
item.description: Nobel laureate James Heckman backed Milei's deregulation drive in Buenos Aires, calling Argentina's reform experiment 'very important' and the country's outlook 'at least a hope.'

item.title: US deports 101 people to Haiti on third weekly flight
item.description: The third consecutive weekly flight carried 101 deportees from Louisiana to northern Haiti amid escalating gang violence and a Level 4 travel warning.

item.title: Burgum announces triumphal arch excavation to begin within two weeks
item.description: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum said excavation on the 250-foot structure on Columbia Island will start within two weeks, as a legal challenge remains pending.

item.title: Mexico's tech exports surpass transport sector, reach record $125B
item.description: UBS and U.S. government data show Mexico's tech shipments to the United States hit records in 2026, overtaking the auto sector.

item.title: Cruz Azul vs. Santos Laguna kickoff moved three hours earlier
item.description: Liga MX moved the Cruz Azul–Santos Laguna kickoff three hours earlier to avoid a clash with the Leagues Cup final on September 6.

item.title: Pew survey finds Latinos split on American Dream achievability
item.description: A Pew survey of nearly 5,000 Latino adults shows deep splits on whether the American Dream exists, is achievable, or is already won.

item.title: Musk's America PAC reports $800,000 in first midterm spending
item.description: Elon Musk's America PAC disclosed just over $800,000 in first midterm expenditures, with nearly 90 percent directed at Senate contests.

item.title: Fox News parts ways with anchor Maria Bartiromo after 12 years
item.description: Fox News announced the immediate departure of anchor Maria Bartiromo on September 3, 2026, after more than 12 years, citing a business decision.

item.title: Flock Safety cameras emerge as issue in 2026 midterm races
item.description: Candidates in Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, Michigan, and Florida have moved against AI-powered license plate readers, while law enforcement officials defend the technology.

item.title: Trump names Adam Telle acting Army secretary after Driscoll resigns
item.description: Adam Telle's elevation to acting Army secretary raises durable questions about civilian control, institutional continuity, and the cost of leadership churn in wartime.

item.title: Trump warns Britain of disaster; Vance declines to call Iran conflict a war
item.description: Trump told GB News Britain is 'on the edge of disaster' as Vance declined to call U.S.-Iran exchanges a war at the first White House briefing in 40 days.

item.title: Miami fintech Félix raises $200M to expand beyond remittances
item.description: The Miami startup hits a $1.4 billion valuation and plans to move from money transfers into lending, savings, and AI financial coaching.

item.title: Inter Miami hosts Atlanta United in adidas night at Nu Stadium
item.description: Inter Miami host struggling Atlanta United on Saturday in an adidas-branded night that ends with a Special Olympics match at Nu Stadium.

item.title: Lawmakers and advocates press Capitol Hill to extend El Salvador TPS
item.description: With El Salvador's TPS set to expire September 9, lawmakers, faith leaders, and advocates are pressing DHS for an extension as the administration signals skepticism.

item.title: Noah Allen transfers to Chicago Fire, clearing Messi's path to appearance record
item.description: Inter Miami loans defender Noah Allen to Chicago Fire for $3 million, leaving Lionel Messi chasing an appearance record he cannot break until 2027.
